name: Chrome Cyan Wobbler
promptTemplate: A demoscene sine wobbler rendering a {{emblem_style}} emblem in {{color_mode}} with {{glitch_burst}} distortion, running slice height {{slice_height}}, wave depth {{wave_depth}}, and wave speed {{wave_speed}}.

ui.title: CYAN WOBBLER +6
ui.tagline: Classic raster sine flag routine in pure chrome

emblem_style.hint: Swap the chrome emblem rendered to the buffer

glitch_burst.hint: Select standard sine, alternate phase, or beat jitter

slice_height.hint: Raster scanline thickness in source pixels

wave_depth.hint: Horizontal displacement of the raster slices

wave_speed.hint: Dial up the sine ripple frequency

gallery.blurb: A sine wobbler: a bold geometric emblem drawn once offscreen, then redrawn row by row with each row shifted by layered sine waves so it ripples like a flag, in chrome and cyan.
gallery.prompt: A sine wobbler: a bold geometric emblem drawn once offscreen, then redrawn row by row with each row shifted by layered sine waves so it ripples like a flag, in chrome and cyan. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
